MAGICSWORDSMAN-SUMMONING_DRAUGHT.title: Summoning Draught
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SUMMONING_DRAUGHT.descrip:
Choose one of your swords that has not come out this combat, summon it and make it your [gold]current sword[/gold].
Put {Cards} random {Cards:plural:card|cards} of that sword from your draw pile into your hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-PURIFYING_WATER.title: Purifying Water
MAGICSWORDSMAN-PURIFYING_WATER.descripti:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Status and Curse cards in your hand.
Remove one of your debuffs.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-QUENCHING_WATER.title: Quenching Water
MAGICSWORDSMAN-QUENCHING_WATER.descripti: This combat, your [gold]current sword[/gold] counts as {Levels} {Levels:plural:level|levels} higher (max 5). If you have no current sword, choose one of your swords.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BLADE_ESSENCE.title: Blade Essence
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BLADE_ESSENCE.description: This turn, sword cards in your hand cost {CostReduction} less (min 0).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WHETSTONE_OIL.title: Whetstone Oil
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WHETSTONE_OIL.description:
This combat, your [gold]current sword[/gold] counts as {Levels} level higher (max 5). With no current sword, choose one of your swords.
Draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RALLYING_INCENSE.title: Rallying Incense
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RALLYING_INCENSE.descript:
Summon a random sword of yours that has not come out this combat and make it your [gold]current sword[/gold].
Draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_ECHO.title: Echo of the Tomb
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_ECHO.description: Choose 1 of 3 cards of magic swords you do not own and put it into your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEART_TO_HEART_TEA.title: Heart-to-Heart Tea
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEART_TO_HEART_TEA.descri:
Your [gold]current sword[/gold] gains {Affinity} affinity.
Then draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}, plus 1 more per affinity tier of that sword (Familiar 1, Trusted 2, Bonded 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SEALING_SALT.title: Sealing Salt
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SEALING_SALT.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] every sword curse in your hand, draw pile and discard pile (this combat only).
Gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold] for each curse Exhausted.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_CUP_WINE.title: Twin-Cup Wine
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_CUP_WINE.description:
This turn, the [gold]Pair[/gold] of every Ganjiang/Moye card always triggers.
This turn, your next card is played twice.
